_comment: Lenny's Podcast's own Shorts caption, measured off three of their published shorts (N_3pPQp7CkQ, lPpEynndz-w, tlTKTV40Mqg) at native 1080x1920: a square-cornered black box at ~55% opacity, white bold SENTENCE CASE (never uppercase -- that is the tell), 3-5 words, one line, parked high enough to clear the Shorts UI. Authored on a 1920x1080 canvas like every preset here, so each value is the 1080x1920 measurement / 1.7778; rendering it to 1080x1920 scales it back and reproduces the measurement. The ONE deliberate departure from their look is states.active: they run a flat static block with no per-word highlight, and the moving spotlight is the upgrade the pitch is about. Its colour is not invented -- it is sampled from the campfire in their own logo bug.

_measured.box_opacity: inside/outside brightness 62/138 and 65/140 over a bright shoulder => ~55% black => ASS alpha 115
_measured.case: sentence case, as spoken -- not uppercase
_measured.logo_flame: #F08820 dominant, #F0B018 core (sampled where the bug sits on a bright wall, tlTKTV40Mqg)
_measured.what_they_do_NOT_do: no per-word highlight, no pop, no rule, no outline -- a flat static block per line
_measured.grouping_swept: max_words x max_line_width_px swept on clip 01 with the builder's wrap/orphan counters. The shipped-then-fixed setting (5 x 400) was the WORST cell: 67% of cards wrapped and 7 orphaned a single word onto its own line -- 'the models are going / to'. 4 x 470 gives 4% wrapped, 0 orphans, 3.9 words/card; 3 x 470 gives 0% but cards change too fast. Chose 4 x 470.
_measured.punctuation: They KEEP it. Contact strip off lPpEynndz-w shows 'in the right direction.', 'press Tab,"', 'to take this thing next?', 'that power of intuition,'. So strip_trailing is EMPTY here -- the ',' it inherited from red-card was stripping commas they keep.
_measured.lines_per_card: always one, 3-5 words, in every frame sampled
_measured.wrap_policy: wrap 'no_orphan' is measured off their own shorts: their caption block legitimately wraps to two lines, but never strands a single word -- our 'the models are going / to' orphan (2026-09-03) was off-style. layout() rebalances the last line; groups are untouched.
_measured.caption_band: measure-caption-band.py over their three cached shorts (48 frames each, temporal dark-card+light-text signal): text-band bottom sits 628 px above the frame bottom in N_3pPQp7CkQ and lPpEynndz-w, but 498 px in tlTKTV40Mqg -- the short from THIS episode's tight talking-head framing, where the face is large and 628 would chase the chin. Our renders at the old 339 (=602 output) measured 622 with the same tool: position matched their cross-episode median exactly, and still read awkward, because our face-tracked crop is tight like tlTKTV40Mqg, not loose like the other two. So the preset follows their same-framing choice: 270 authoring = 480 output card bottom, text band ~500 from bottom, matching their 498, ~100 px clear of the Shorts UI band, and buying ~120 px more chin clearance. Re-measure with the tool after any crop change; do not average their shorts without checking which framing each was made for.

overlays._note: Colour of the SOURCE video's own lower-third graphics to dodge (not your card colour). Targeted mode is reliable; auto is experimental and false-positives on saturated props.
